description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Nervous Gardener enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.
